grade_reason: Cooke spoke about AI in 2026 (deepfakes in elections and a data center moratorium), but no statement acknowledging catastrophic risk from AI was found.
notes: Six web searches ran, all listed; none was refused. Search results did not surface any Cooke statement on superintelligence, extinction, AI safety, a pause, or China. The WisPolitics item on her data center moratorium ad (28 August 2026) is paywalled; the only visible Cooke wording was that she does not want to be "beholden to any of these big tech companies", and her full reasons for the moratorium could not be read. A Berge campaign release (3 August 2026, https://www.wispolitics.com/?p=422658) urged Cooke to back a federal moratorium on large AI data centers until Congress sets AI rules; it has no Cooke wording. WPR paraphrases Cooke as backing the Protect Elections from Deceptive AI Act; not quoted. A Van Orden campaign attack says she sat on the Wisconsin Technology Council board, which promoted data centers; partisan claim, not checked. The campaign site could not be read (rebeccaforwisconsin.com does not resolve; rebeccacooke.com returned only a tracking page). No source shows her co-sponsoring the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act; she was not in Congress in 2026.
